title: Booking Amounts by Lead Time of the Overnight Travel Permission — UIL Travel Fee Schedule, Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees
content:
**Booking amount.** For a UIL Academic and Robotics Team participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03, a booking amount of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees** is added after the shares by the calendar days from the received date of the latest overnight travel permission form on the participation's records log to the first of the team's trips on or after that date: 20.00 when there are fewer than 21 days, 10.00 when there are 21 days or more but fewer than 30 days, and nothing otherwise or when none of the trips falls on or after that date.

The latest form is the one with the latest received date among the overnight travel permission forms on that participation's records log. The team's trips:

| Activity | Competition trips of the 2026-27 school year |
|---|---|
| robotics | 2026-10-17, 2026-12-05, 2027-02-20, 2027-04-17 |
| one-act play | 2026-10-24, 2026-12-12, 2027-03-20, 2027-04-24 |
| any other activity of the type (UIL academics) | 2026-11-07, 2027-01-30, 2027-03-27, 2027-04-24 |

| Calendar days from that received date to the first trip on or after it | Booking amount |
|---|---|
| 0 to 20 | 20.00 |
| 21 to 29 | 10.00 |
| 30 or more | nothing |
| no trip on or after the received date | nothing |

## Boundary cases on the robotics trip of 2026-10-17 (hypothetical received dates)

| Received date | Days to 2026-10-17 | Booking amount |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-09-27 | 20 | 20.00 |
| 2026-09-26 | 21 | 10.00 |
| 2026-09-18 | 29 | 10.00 |
| 2026-09-17 | 30 | nothing |
| 2027-04-18 | no robotics trip on or after it | nothing |

A form received on a trip day counts 0 days to that trip, fewer than 21.
